description: A unit citing a withdrawn Need. The ref resolves; staleness is reserved-code territory.
specRow: S9.4 NEED-REF-001 does not fire when the ref resolves to a Need of any status, including withdrawn.

needsDocument.title: Benefits assistance -- who this is for and why

statement.who: anyone submitting this application under a deadline
statement.want: a receipt I can save and show someone later
statement.why: if the agency loses my submission, I lose rights I actually had
statement.done: after I submit, I hold a receipt that proves what I filed and when

statement.who: anyone waiting on a decision about their application
statement.want: to check what is happening to my case without calling anyone
statement.why: people give up on help they are entitled to when they cannot tell whether anything is moving
statement.done: I can look at one place and see where my application is and what happens next
